scope: local isolated QEMU; explicit functional graphics and AP framebuffer consumer
pixel_model: straight RGBA4444; PNG is direct byte conversion of the QMP readback
visible_content: Original language selection page: title, English, Japanese, French, German, Italian, selection highlight, scrollbar, bottom icons
osd_log_sampling: First 8 snapshots and subsequent powers of two; logged event count is not total frame count
osd_completion_rule: Native framebuffer semaphore, bitmap reference/read lease and shared raster lock; capture actual pixels; persist and read back; then reply through original 0x6003/0x6005 path
remaining: CMOS, lens, AF, encoding, photo/video and virtual SD acceptance
QEMU ramfb presentation of the original bitmap
